description: This file defines a custom child definition class for HTMLPurifier, handling DTD child patterns and validation logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Custom
classes.description: A class that handles custom child element validation based on DTD patterns, extending the base 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef' class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a DTD regex pattern and compiles it into a PCRE regex.

methods.name: _compileRegex
methods.description: Converts the DTD regex pattern into a PCRE regex used for validation.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates a sequence of tokens against the compiled regex to ensure children conform to the pattern.
